attributes.context: This is in Article IX, Section 9.1(C), within layoff provisions that restrict layoffs and hour reductions for employees not yet on the regular payroll, except for seasonal layoffs, shutdowns, discontinued services, or significant technological change, while preserving the University's right to suspend, discipline, or discharge for just cause.

extraction_text: No employee as defined in Section 1.2 A. and 1.2 B. of this Agreement who is not yet on the regular payroll as of the signing of this Agreement shall be laid off or have their hours of work reduced during the term of this Agreement except for annual temporary seasonal layoffs, shut-down of an operation or work unit, the service performed by bargaining unit employees is to be discontinued or there is a significant technological change, provided that nothing herein shall impair the University's right to suspend, discipline or discharge employees for just cause.

attributes.context: This clause appears in Article XXIV, Training and education, and is followed by Section 24.2, which provides 50% tuition reimbursement for qualified employees who complete job-related courses or authorized training programs.

extraction_text: The Parties agree that it is mutually advantageous for employees in more skilled or specialized jobs to have the opportunity to keep abreast of developments and improvements in the technologies, methods, and materials related to their trades.

attributes.context: Section 22.4 establishes a Joint Labor-Management Best Practices Committee for new and existing buildings; surrounding text describes demonstration buildings and conditions such as mutual agreement on best practices, training, and staffing by Local 35.

extraction_text: The Committee shall then develop "best practices" for the buildings referred to in this Section and where appropriate research, identify, and review existing industry standards and practices; solicit employee, management and stakeholder input; solicit outside technical assistance; assess future trends in technology, and their likely impact on staffing; review safety considerations for trade related work; review subcontractors practices and results and determine their effectiveness against industry standards; develop and implement metrics and measures, including financial performance, efficiency and quality; review current work rules and the utilization of people, training, investment in technology and equipment, job descriptions, staffing etc., for necessary modifications in order to implement "best practices;" review and monitor results and compliance with best practices that are implemented.

attributes.context: Surrounding text provides that emergency callbacks and standby duty are first offered to bargaining unit employees, with exceptions, and that the new callback system uses a beeper and a priority-based response window in specified Physical Plant trades.

extraction_text: The University may introduce a new system for expediting call back calls, including the following provisions: 1) In the control mechanics, equipment mechanics, plumbing and electrical trades the University will furnish any employee interested in accepting callbacks a beeper. The University will beep all employees when a callback is available. Employees will have ten (10) minutes to call the control center and express interest in the work. The work will be offered to the employee (or employees where multiple employees are required) with the highest priority position on the callback list who responds during the ten- (10) minute period.

attributes.context: The surrounding text is a Physical Plant subcontracting provision that also describes the remedy for equipment or dispatcher error and requires that subcontractor overtime work in bargaining unit areas be offered first to bargaining unit employees.

extraction_text: to a new system, the University and Union Physical Plant subcommittee representatives for the affected area will meet to work out the detailed implementation of the system and to discuss measures to make the callback systems work better including purging lists.
